note: A stand-in set written for this site: sixty answers by Larkspur's support assistant, each with a hand-set confidence set to show the overconfidence Guo et al. (2017) report. Not a real model's answers or scores. Each is graded live by Evals' key-fact check: against Evals' reference where `evals` names one, otherwise against data/calibration/references.json.

kinds.label: Orders and delivery
kinds.about: Shipping times, pickup, tracking and the Portal's ordering steps.

kinds.label: Refunds and billing
kinds.about: Refunds, returns, invoices and payment terms.

kinds.label: Product questions
kinds.about: Specs, prices and fit for scanners, printers, shelving and sensors.

answers.question: If I order before lunch, does it ship today?
answers.text: Yes: in-stock orders placed before 2 p.m. Central time on a business day ship the same day.
answers.note: Right: one plain line in the shipping policy.

answers.question: Do you ship on Saturdays?
answers.text: No. Orders are picked and shipped on business days only.
answers.note: Right: the shipping FAQ says so directly.

answers.question: How long does standard ground delivery take?
answers.text: Standard ground delivery takes three to five business days.

answers.question: How fast is expedited delivery?
answers.text: Expedited delivery takes two business days.

answers.question: When is parcel shipping free?
answers.text: Parcel shipping is free on orders over $500.

answers.question: Can I collect an order myself?
answers.text: Yes. Choose warehouse pickup at checkout for the Riverbend or Eastgate warehouse.

answers.question: Where do I see tracking for my parcels?
answers.text: Open the order in the Portal to see carrier tracking for every parcel.

answers.question: How much longer do engraved items take?
answers.text: Orders that need custom cutting or engraving add three business days.

answers.question: Can you combine my two orders into one shipment?
answers.text: Yes, always: support can merge any two orders into one shipment.
answers.note: Wrong and sure: only orders still waiting to be picked can be combined.

answers.question: Do back-ordered items cost extra to ship?
answers.text: No. Back-ordered items ship separately at no extra cost.

answers.question: How soon must I report a damaged delivery?
answers.text: Report damage within five days of delivery, with photos of the carton and the item.

answers.question: Can you send a truck with a liftgate for my shelving?
answers.text: Yes. Add the liftgate option when you book the freight appointment.

answers.question: How do I order the same things again?
answers.text: Open Order history and choose Reorder on any past order.

answers.question: Why is my order stuck as waiting?
answers.text: Your admin has set an approval rule; it goes to the warehouse once an approver accepts it.

answers.question: Where do I change my delivery address?
answers.text: Open Settings, then Addresses.

answers.question: Can I order without a Portal account?
answers.text: No. Every order needs a Portal account so invoices and warranties are tracked.

answers.question: Do you ship to Canada for a small shop?
answers.text: Yes, standard ground delivery reaches neighboring countries in five to eight days.
answers.note: Wrong: international shipping is only for enterprise contracts.

answers.question: Where can I see stock levels?
answers.text: Each product page shows stock at your nearest warehouse.

answers.question: How soon is a freight delivery scheduled?
answers.text: Freight deliveries are scheduled with you within one business day of shipping.

answers.question: What happens if nobody is at the dock for my freight?
answers.text: The driver leaves the pallet at the door.
answers.note: Wrong: the carrier reschedules and a redelivery fee may apply.

answers.question: How long do I have to ask for a refund?
answers.text: Standard customers can request a refund within 30 days of delivery.
answers.note: Right: one line in the refund policy.

answers.question: We're on an enterprise contract. Can we get a refund?
answers.text: No. The refund policy does not apply to enterprise contracts; raise a billing dispute with your account manager.

answers.question: What are the payment terms on a standard account?
answers.text: Standard accounts pay on net 30 terms.

answers.question: How do I start a return?
answers.text: Open the order in the Portal and choose Start return, then print the label.

answers.question: How long until a card refund shows up?
answers.text: Card refunds usually appear within seven business days.

answers.question: Can I get money back for unused months of an annual plan?
answers.text: Yes, unused months on annual plans are refunded pro rata.
answers.note: Wrong and very sure: annual plans are never partly refunded; the plan runs to the end of the term.

answers.question: Can I download an invoice from 2020?
answers.text: Yes. Every invoice since 2019 can be downloaded from the Invoices page.

answers.question: When is the invoice sent?
answers.text: Invoices are emailed the day an order ships.

answers.question: Can I swap an item instead of returning it?
answers.text: Yes. Choose Exchange in the returns center and pick the replacement.

answers.question: How long does a return take once it arrives?
answers.text: Most returns are inspected within five business days of reaching the warehouse.

answers.question: Can I return an opened roll of labels?
answers.text: Yes, any roll can be returned within 30 days.
answers.note: Wrong and sure: only unopened rolls come back.

answers.question: How do I dispute an invoice?
answers.text: Open the invoice and choose Dispute; it goes to your account manager.

answers.question: How is a purchase-order customer refunded?
answers.text: Purchase-order customers receive a credit note for their next invoice.

answers.question: Can I return custom-cut shelving I no longer need?
answers.text: Yes, within 30 days in its original packaging.
answers.note: Wrong and sure: made-to-order items are final sale unless defective.

answers.question: We're tax-exempt. What do we do?
answers.text: Upload your exemption certificate in Settings.

answers.question: What payment terms do enterprise accounts get?
answers.text: Enterprise accounts usually pay on net 45 terms set in their contract.

answers.question: What is the late fee on an unpaid invoice?
answers.text: Late invoices carry a flat $25 fee.
answers.note: Wrong: it is 1.5 percent per month, after 15 days.

answers.question: Can I pay a $1,000 invoice by bank transfer?
answers.text: Not for that amount: bank transfer is for invoices over $2,000.

answers.question: Is a gift card refunded to cash?
answers.text: Gift cards and promotional credit are not refunded to cash.

answers.question: Who pays for return shipping?
answers.text: Larkspur pays return shipping on every return.
answers.note: Wrong: the customer pays unless the item was wrong or defective.

answers.question: What does one Kestrel K3 cost?
answers.text: One Kestrel K3 is $620.

answers.question: What does a Kestrel K2 cost if we buy 60?
answers.text: At 50 or more, a Kestrel K2 is $410 per unit.
answers.note: Right: one row of the price list.

answers.question: How much is a Wren WL-4 printer?
answers.text: A Wren WL-4 label printer is $310 for one to nine units.

answers.question: Will my spare K3 batteries fit our K2 scanners?
answers.text: Yes, K3 batteries fit the K2.
answers.note: Wrong and very sure: the batteries have different shapes.

answers.question: How long is the dock sensor's warranty?
answers.text: The DS-100 has a three-year warranty from the date of shipment.

answers.question: How much weight can one Heron bay hold?
answers.text: Each Heron bay is rated for 900 kilograms.

answers.question: How do I put the Wren printer on Wi-Fi?
answers.text: Hold the feed button for five seconds until the light blinks blue, then finish setup in the Portal.

answers.question: Can K2 and K3 scanners work at the same site?
answers.text: Yes. Both use the same Portal receiving screens and the same Wren printers.

answers.question: Is there a trade-in for an old K2?
answers.text: Return a working K2 and get a $60 credit toward a K3, until the end of 2025.

answers.question: The printer's red light is blinking. Why?
answers.text: A blinking red light means the roll is empty.

answers.question: How often should shelving be inspected?
answers.text: Inspect Heron shelving every six months.

answers.question: Is the dock sensor's battery covered for three years too?
answers.text: Yes, the battery is covered for the full three years.
answers.note: Wrong and very sure: batteries are warranted for one year.

answers.question: What temperatures can the dock sensor handle?
answers.text: The DS-100 is rated from minus 30 to plus 60 degrees Celsius.

answers.question: Does a 2.8 m Heron bay need anything beyond floor bolts?
answers.text: No. Floor bolts are enough for any Heron bay.
answers.note: Wrong and sure: bays over 2.5 m must also be tied to a wall or another bay.

answers.question: How many labels come in the Wren starter roll?
answers.text: The starter roll holds 500 labels.

answers.question: What does a 1,000-label roll cost in tens?
answers.text: A 1,000-label roll is $14 each at any quantity.
answers.note: Wrong and sure: it is $12 each from 10 to 49.

answers.question: Is the K2 still for sale now the K3 is out?
answers.text: Yes. The K2 stays in the catalog through at least 2026.

answers.question: How soon does a K3 ship after I order?
answers.text: K3 orders ship the same day if placed before 2 p.m.
answers.note: Wrong: the launch FAQ says within two weeks.

answers.question: A forklift hit our dock sensor. Is that covered?
answers.text: No. Forklift impact is excluded from the warranty.

answers.question: How often should the print head be cleaned?
answers.text: Clean the print head every 50 rolls.
answers.note: Wrong: every five rolls, or sooner if labels look faded.
